objective_for_doctor:
Age: 42
Sex: Male
Chief Complaint: I have stridor

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
Hi doctor. I’m here because I have stridor—like a noisy breathing sound when I breathe. I also had a cold in the last two weeks, and I have gastroesophageal reflux.
[ASK] Do you have sudden shortness of breath that started within the last few hours?
I’m not sure it was within just the last few hours. It’s been going on with the breathing noise, but I can’t say it started suddenly in the last few hours.
[ASK] Are you currently having chest pain or discomfort that is worse with breathing (pleuritic) or coughing, or do you have sudden shortness of breath?
No, I don’t have chest pain or discomfort, and it’s not worse with breathing or coughing. I also don’t have sudden shortness of breath.
[ASK] Are you currently having chest pain or pressure that is worse with exertion or does not go away within 10–15 minutes?
No chest pain or pressure with exertion, and nothing that doesn’t go away within 10–15 minutes.
No. I’m not having anaphylaxis. I don’t have any swelling or rash that I can tell you about.
No, I’m not having PSVT. My heart feels normal to me.
No, I’m not having sarcoidosis—at least I’ve never been told I have it.
[DDX] Acute dystonic reactions, Anaphylaxis, Atrial fibrillation  , PSVT, Sarcoidosis
